attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its body is two sentences: he came from Bulgaria, he was martyred in 1555, and «Δεν έχουμε περισσότερες λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο και το μαρτύριο του Αγίου». **He is not the day's other Nicholas**: the corpus's [Nicholas of Metsovo](/saints/nicholas-of-metsovo), whom saint.gr also keeps on this same 17 May with a page of its own, is a neomartyr of Epirus who died at Trikala in 1617 — a different country, a different year and a full life against none. **The display name carries the country and the day** and not the rank, which `types` composes; the country is the only thing the page gives him besides the year, and the day tells him from the corpus's other Nicholases. **No `locations` object.** No hymn is printed.
